calls.title: Blog Refinement
calls.summary: The team discussed key enhancements to the blog's usability, focusing on readability, spacing, and functionality. Karen Henke highlighted the need for narrower column widths and improved heading differentiation. Suggestions included adjusting the table of contents (TOC) and moving the subscription form for better accessibility. Recommendations for increased padding and spacing were made to support detailed, long-form content. The team also addressed the importance of standardized image guidelines for editorial consistency. Finally, they emphasized that style changes would have a cross-page impact, ensuring coherence in design and UX.
calls.keywords: blog styling, readability, table of contents, subscription form, typography, image guidelines
